absence: The sheet names opportunities, risks and markets. It states no status or suggested monitoring indicators.

focusItems.focus: Naval & Government Maritime
focusItems.whyItMatters: Defence/naval/coast guard budget changes; fleet modernisation; new shipbuilding and MRO programmes; tenders/RFIs; G2G opportunities and customer procurement strategies.

focusItems.focus: International MRO & Lifecycle Support
focusItems.whyItMatters: MRO, fleet sustainment, in-service support and long-term maintenance opportunities, including opportunities for predictive/condition-based maintenance and digital services.

focusItems.focus: AI-Enabled Shipbuilding & Smart Yard
focusItems.whyItMatters: Developments in AI-enabled planning and scheduling, integrated shipbuilding management, digital twins, IoT/sensorisation, video analytics, robotics and automation that could improve throughput, cost, schedule and yard utilisation. Marine’s roadmap targets a connected AI-enabled Shipbuilding Management System and ultimately smart-yard capabilities.

focusItems.focus: Advanced Engineering & Unmanned Systems
focusItems.whyItMatters: AI-assisted vessel design/optimisation; autonomous and unmanned vessels/drones; USV/UUV technologies; advanced systems integration and relevant technology partnerships. Marine’s roadmap specifically includes AI-assisted design and next-generation USV hull-form development.

focusItems.focus: Smart Ship & Predictive Maintenance
focusItems.whyItMatters: AI-enabled ship-management systems, vessel-performance optimisation, condition-based/predictive maintenance, sensorisation, digital watchkeeping and safety/compliance applications.

focusItems.focus: Alternative Energy
focusItems.whyItMatters: Emerging propulsion/energy technologies for naval and commercial vessels, including hybrid/electric systems and alternative fuels; associated newbuild, conversion and retrofit opportunities.

focusItems.focus: Offshore Renewables & Infrastructure
focusItems.whyItMatters: Offshore wind and infrastructure developments creating demand for specialised vessels, shipbuilding and lifecycle-support services.

focusItems.focus: Partnerships & Integrated Solutions
focusItems.whyItMatters: Competitor/shipyard developments, JVs and technology partnerships; opportunities for collaboration with Digital Systems and Land Systems to offer differentiated integrated solutions.

focusItems.focus: Future Workforce & Productivity
focusItems.whyItMatters: Technologies, workforce models and skills required for AI, robotics, autonomy, advanced engineering and alternative energy; opportunities for reskilling, knowledge retention and productivity improvement. Marine’s roadmap targets higher productivity and greater output from the same workforce.

focusItems.focus: Geopolitical/security risks affecting naval programmes, market access, maritime routes or customer priorities.
Sanctions, export controls and technology-transfer restrictions, particularly for defence, AI, autonomous and advanced systems.
Localisation and regulatory requirements, including industrial participation and local-content obligations.
Competitor and shipyard actions, including major contract wins, technology advances, alliances/JVs and capacity expansion.
Foreign partner risks, including capability, integrity, ownership/control and geopolitical exposure.
Supply-chain/logistics disruption, critical components, strategic shipping routes and supplier dependencies.
Workforce/visa/skills constraints affecting overseas mobilisation and programme execution.
Cyber, AI and data risks affecting smart yards, connected vessels, AI systems, digital twins, autonomous platforms and operational technology.
Technology disruption, particularly advances that could make Marine’s existing capabilities less competitive.
Programme execution risks, including cost, schedule, infrastructure and resource constraints.
Priority markets: Saudi Arabia, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Japan, Poland, USA and UK.
focusItems.whyItMatters: Give enhanced coverage to Saudi Arabia, particularly for Naval New Build and MRO opportunities, localisation requirements, partners, workforce/visa considerations and supply-chain/execution risks. Do not restrict emerging technology intelligence to the above markets. Monitor globally for significant developments in AI-enabled shipbuilding, smart yards, Digital Twin, autonomous/unmanned systems, predictive maintenance, robotics, alternative energy and offshore renewables.

focusItems.focus: Opportunity/watchlist markets: Estonia, Lithuania, Sweden, Denmark, Germany, Canada, Chile, Israel and Greece.
